description: Process a permit application from intake through technical review to issuance.

steps.description: Receive and log an incoming permit application.

inputs.name: application-documents
inputs.desc: The submitted permit application and supporting documents

inputs.name: permit-type
inputs.desc: The type of permit being requested (building, zoning, special use, etc.)

outputs.name: application-record
outputs.desc: Logged application with tracking number and timestamp

outputs.name: completeness-checklist
outputs.desc: Checklist of required documents and their submission status

process: Assign a tracking number and log the application in the permit system.
Check all submitted documents against the required document list for the permit type.
Note any missing or incomplete items on the completeness checklist.
Notify the applicant of any deficiencies within the required timeframe.

steps.description: Verify the application is complete and ready for technical review.

outputs.name: verified-application
outputs.desc: Application confirmed complete and ready for review

outputs.name: review-routing
outputs.desc: Assigned reviewer and review type based on permit category

process: Confirm all required documents are present and legible.
Verify fees have been paid or payment is pending.
Route the application to the appropriate technical reviewer based on permit type.
Set the review deadline per the jurisdiction's processing timeline.

steps.description: Conduct the technical review of the permit application against applicable codes and standards.

outputs.name: review-findings
outputs.desc: Technical findings, code citations, and any required corrections

outputs.name: review-recommendation
outputs.desc: Recommendation to approve, approve with conditions, or deny

process: Review the application against the applicable building codes, zoning ordinances, or regulations.
Document any non-compliance items with specific code citations.
Determine whether the application can be approved, needs corrections, or must be denied.
Write the recommendation with conditions if applicable.

steps.description: Issue the permit decision and collect fees.

inputs.name: review-recommendation
inputs.desc: Approval, conditional approval, or denial recommendation

outputs.name: permit-decision
outputs.desc: The official permit decision with any conditions

outputs.name: permit-record
outputs.desc: Complete permit record including decision, fees, and conditions

process: Prepare the permit decision document based on the review recommendation.
Collect any remaining fees.
Issue the permit or denial notice to the applicant.
Record the decision in the permit tracking system.

description: Manage public records from classification through retention to public records request fulfillment.

steps.description: Define the records retention schedule with retention periods, disposition methods, and access levels.

inputs.name: record-types
inputs.desc: List of record types the organization produces or receives

outputs.name: retention-schedule
outputs.desc: Schedule mapping each record type to its retention period and disposition method

outputs.name: access-matrix
outputs.desc: Matrix defining access levels (public, restricted, exempt) for each record type

process: Inventory all record types by department and function.
Map each record type to the applicable legal retention requirement.
Assign disposition methods (archive, destroy, transfer) for each type.
Define access levels based on legal exemptions and operational needs.

steps.description: Classify incoming records according to the retention schedule.

outputs.name: classified-records
outputs.desc: Records tagged with type, retention period, and access level

outputs.name: storage-assignments
outputs.desc: Where each record is stored in the records management system

process: Match each incoming record to its type in the retention schedule.
Tag the record with its retention period and disposition date.
Assign the access level from the access matrix.
File the record in the designated storage location.

steps.description: Process public records requests (FOIA or state equivalent).

outputs.name: responsive-records
outputs.desc: Records identified as responsive to the request, with redactions applied

outputs.name: request-response
outputs.desc: Formal response to the requester including any exemption citations

process: Log the request and acknowledge receipt within the legal timeframe.
Search for records responsive to the request.
Review responsive records for exempt information and apply redactions.
Prepare and deliver the response with any exemption citations.

steps.description: Execute the disposition of records that have reached the end of their retention period.

inputs.name: responsive-records
inputs.desc: Records that have been through the request cycle

inputs.name: request-response
inputs.desc: Any pending legal holds or requests

outputs.name: disposition-log
outputs.desc: Log of records destroyed, archived, or transferred

outputs.name: records-management-report
outputs.desc: Summary report of records management activity

process: Identify records that have reached their retention end date.
Verify no legal holds or pending requests apply to those records.
Execute the disposition (destroy, archive, or transfer) per the schedule.
Log all disposition actions for the audit trail.

description: Handle constituent service requests from intake through resolution and reporting.

steps.description: Receive and categorize a constituent service request.

inputs.name: request-details
inputs.desc: The constituent's request (issue description, contact info, preferred response method)

inputs.name: service-catalog
inputs.desc: Catalog of services and responsible departments

outputs.name: categorized-request
outputs.desc: Request categorized by type and assigned a tracking number

outputs.name: department-routing
outputs.desc: The department and contact responsible for handling the request

process: Log the request with a unique tracking number.
Categorize the issue by type (pothole, zoning question, utility, general inquiry, complaint).
Match the category to the responsible department in the service catalog.
Send the constituent an acknowledgment with the tracking number.

steps.description: Route and resolve the constituent's request.

outputs.name: resolution-record
outputs.desc: Record of what was done to resolve the request

outputs.name: constituent-response
outputs.desc: Response sent to the constituent with the outcome

process: Assign the request to the responsible staff member.
Track the resolution progress against the service level target.
Document the resolution actions taken.
Send the constituent the outcome and close the request.

steps.description: Report on constituent service metrics and trends.

outputs.name: service-metrics
outputs.desc: Metrics on request volume, resolution time, and satisfaction

outputs.name: constituent-services-report
outputs.desc: Summary report on constituent services performance

process: Aggregate request data by category, department, and time period.
Calculate resolution time, first-contact resolution rate, and backlog.
Identify the top issue categories and any emerging trends.
Produce the constituent services performance report.

description: Manage the government budget appropriation cycle from budget call through adoption.

steps.description: Issue the budget call with instructions and templates to departments.

inputs.name: budget-guidelines
inputs.desc: Policy guidelines, constraints, and priorities for the budget cycle

outputs.name: budget-call-package
outputs.desc: The budget call document with instructions and submission templates

outputs.name: submission-deadline
outputs.desc: Deadline and schedule for department budget submissions

process: Prepare the budget call letter with fiscal year priorities and constraints.
Include submission templates, baseline figures, and instructions.
Set the submission deadline and review schedule.
Distribute to all department heads.

steps.description: Collect and consolidate department budget requests.

outputs.name: consolidated-budget
outputs.desc: All department requests consolidated into a single budget document

outputs.name: variance-analysis
outputs.desc: Analysis of changes from the prior year and from the baseline

process: Collect budget submissions from each department.
Verify submissions are complete and follow the required format.
Consolidate all requests into the unified budget document.
Calculate variances from the prior year and from the baseline for each line item.

steps.description: Review the consolidated budget and present it to the governing body.

outputs.name: budget-presentation
outputs.desc: Presentation-ready budget summary with recommendations

outputs.name: amendments-list
outputs.desc: List of amendments from the governing body's review

process: Prepare the budget summary with revenue projections and expenditure totals.
Highlight key variances, new requests, and recommended adjustments.
Present to the governing body and record their questions and amendments.
Compile the amendments list for incorporation.

steps.description: Incorporate amendments and finalize the adopted budget.

outputs.name: adopted-budget
outputs.desc: The final adopted budget document

outputs.name: budget-document
outputs.desc: Published budget document for the fiscal year

process: Incorporate all approved amendments into the budget.
Verify the budget balances (revenues equal or exceed expenditures).
Prepare the final budget document for adoption vote.
Publish the adopted budget and distribute to departments.

description: Run a public procurement bid process from solicitation through contract award.

steps.description: Draft the procurement solicitation document (RFP, RFQ, or IFB).

inputs.name: procurement-need
inputs.desc: Description of what is being procured (goods, services, or construction)

inputs.name: procurement-method
inputs.desc: The solicitation type (RFP, RFQ, IFB) and applicable procurement rules

outputs.name: solicitation-document
outputs.desc: The draft solicitation with scope, requirements, evaluation criteria, and terms

outputs.name: evaluation-criteria
outputs.desc: Scoring criteria and weights for bid evaluation

process: Define the scope of work or specifications.
Set the evaluation criteria and their weights.
Include the required terms, conditions, and certifications.
Set the submission deadline and question period.

steps.description: Receive bids and evaluate them against the criteria.

outputs.name: bid-scores
outputs.desc: Each bid scored against the evaluation criteria

outputs.name: evaluation-summary
outputs.desc: Summary of the evaluation with ranking and recommendation

process: Receive and log all bids by the submission deadline.
Verify each bid meets the minimum requirements and is responsive.
Score each bid against the evaluation criteria.
Rank the bids and prepare the evaluation summary with a recommendation.

steps.description: Award the contract and execute the agreement.

outputs.name: contract-award
outputs.desc: The contract award notice and executed agreement

outputs.name: procurement-record
outputs.desc: Complete procurement file for the record

process: Select the winning bidder based on the evaluation ranking.
Issue the notice of intent to award and observe the protest period.
Execute the contract with the selected vendor.
Compile the complete procurement file for record retention.

description: Manage a public meeting from agenda preparation through minutes publication.

steps.description: Prepare the meeting agenda and required public notices.

inputs.name: meeting-items
inputs.desc: List of items to be discussed or acted upon

outputs.name: meeting-agenda
outputs.desc: The formatted meeting agenda

outputs.name: public-notice
outputs.desc: The public notice meeting legal posting requirements

process: Compile the agenda items with descriptions and any required attachments.
Format the agenda per the governing body's standard template.
Prepare the public notice with date, time, location, and agenda summary.
Publish the notice within the required legal timeframe.

steps.description: Conduct the public meeting including public comment.

outputs.name: meeting-actions
outputs.desc: Record of all actions taken (votes, motions, decisions)

outputs.name: public-comments
outputs.desc: Summary of public comments received

process: Call the meeting to order and confirm a quorum.
Work through each agenda item, recording motions, seconds, and votes.
Conduct the public comment period and record all comments.
Adjourn the meeting.

steps.description: Record, approve, and publish the meeting minutes.

outputs.name: meeting-minutes
outputs.desc: The official meeting minutes

outputs.name: meeting-record
outputs.desc: Complete meeting record (agenda, minutes, notices, attachments)

process: Draft the minutes from the meeting notes and action record.
Include all motions, votes, and public comments.
Submit the minutes for approval at the next meeting.
Publish the approved minutes and file the complete meeting record.

description: Administer a government grant from award through closeout.

steps.description: Issue the notice of award and execute the grant agreement.

inputs.name: grant-selection
inputs.desc: The selected grantee and award amount

inputs.name: grant-terms
inputs.desc: Terms, conditions, and reporting requirements for the grant

outputs.name: grant-agreement
outputs.desc: The executed grant agreement

outputs.name: monitoring-plan
outputs.desc: Plan for monitoring grantee compliance and progress

process: Prepare and issue the notice of award to the selected grantee.
Negotiate and execute the grant agreement with terms and conditions.
Set up the monitoring plan with reporting dates and compliance checkpoints.
Establish the drawdown and reimbursement procedures.

steps.description: Monitor the grantee's progress and compliance throughout the grant period.

outputs.name: monitoring-findings
outputs.desc: Findings from progress and compliance reviews

outputs.name: drawdown-approvals
outputs.desc: Approved and processed drawdown requests

process: Review the grantee's progress reports against the milestones in the agreement.
Process drawdown or reimbursement requests with supporting documentation.
Conduct site visits or desk reviews per the monitoring plan.
Document any compliance issues and required corrective actions.

steps.description: Close out the grant and produce the final report.

inputs.name: monitoring-findings
inputs.desc: Monitoring findings over the grant period

outputs.name: closeout-package
outputs.desc: Final financial reconciliation and performance report

outputs.name: grant-administration-record
outputs.desc: Complete grant administration file

process: Verify all grant funds are expended or returned.
Reconcile the financial records against the drawdown approvals.
Collect the grantee's final performance report.
Close the grant in the tracking system and archive the file.

description: Enforce building or zoning codes from violation identification through resolution.

steps.description: Identify and document a code violation.

inputs.name: complaint-or-observation
inputs.desc: The complaint received or inspector observation that triggered the case

inputs.name: applicable-codes
inputs.desc: The building, zoning, or property maintenance codes that apply

outputs.name: violation-documentation
outputs.desc: Documented violation with photos, location, and code citations

outputs.name: inspection-report
outputs.desc: Formal inspection report with findings

process: Conduct the site inspection and document the conditions with photos.
Identify the specific code sections being violated.
Record the violation details including location, severity, and responsible party.
Prepare the formal inspection report.

steps.description: Issue the notice of violation and set the compliance deadline.

outputs.name: violation-notice
outputs.desc: The official notice of violation sent to the property owner

outputs.name: compliance-deadline
outputs.desc: Deadline for the owner to correct the violation

process: Prepare the notice of violation citing the specific code sections.
Set the compliance deadline based on violation severity.
Deliver the notice to the property owner via the required method.
Log the notice in the enforcement tracking system.

steps.description: Verify correction or escalate the violation.

outputs.name: compliance-status
outputs.desc: Whether the violation was corrected, partially corrected, or unresolved

outputs.name: enforcement-record
outputs.desc: Complete enforcement case record

process: Conduct a follow-up inspection after the compliance deadline.
Determine whether the violation has been corrected.
If unresolved, escalate to fines, liens, or legal action per the enforcement policy.
Close the case if corrected, or document the escalation and next steps.

description: Develop an emergency management plan from hazard assessment through tabletop exercise.

steps.description: Conduct the hazard identification and risk assessment.

inputs.name: jurisdiction-profile
inputs.desc: Geographic, demographic, and infrastructure profile of the jurisdiction

inputs.name: historical-incidents
inputs.desc: History of past emergencies and disasters in the area

outputs.name: hazard-inventory
outputs.desc: List of hazards with likelihood and impact ratings

outputs.name: risk-priorities
outputs.desc: Hazards ranked by risk level for planning priority

process: Identify all natural, technological, and human-caused hazards relevant to the jurisdiction.
Assess the likelihood and potential impact of each hazard.
Rank hazards by overall risk level.
Map vulnerable populations and critical infrastructure for each high-priority hazard.

steps.description: Define the emergency operations center structure and roles.

outputs.name: eoc-org-chart
outputs.desc: Organizational chart for the emergency operations center using ICS

outputs.name: role-assignments
outputs.desc: Roles and responsibilities for each EOC position

process: Design the EOC organizational structure using the Incident Command System.
Define the roles, responsibilities, and authority for each position.
Identify primary and backup personnel for each role.
Document the activation triggers and staffing levels for each emergency tier.

steps.description: Write the standard operating procedures for each priority hazard.

outputs.name: emergency-sops
outputs.desc: Standard operating procedures for each priority hazard

outputs.name: notification-procedures
outputs.desc: Public notification and evacuation procedures

process: Write the response procedures for each priority hazard.
Define the public notification methods (sirens, mass notifications, media).
Document the evacuation routes, shelter locations, and special needs procedures.
Include mutual aid agreements and resource request procedures.

steps.description: Conduct a tabletop exercise to test the emergency management plan.

outputs.name: exercise-findings
outputs.desc: Findings from the tabletop exercise including gaps and improvement areas

outputs.name: emergency-management-plan
outputs.desc: The finalized emergency management plan incorporating exercise lessons

process: Design the exercise scenario based on a priority hazard.
Facilitate the tabletop exercise with EOC personnel and partner agencies.
Document decisions, gaps, and improvement opportunities during the exercise.
Update the emergency management plan based on exercise findings.

description: Administer an election from logistics planning through results certification.

steps.description: Plan the election logistics including polling locations, equipment, and staffing.

inputs.name: election-type
inputs.desc: The type of election (general, primary, special, municipal)

inputs.name: jurisdiction-data
inputs.desc: Registered voter counts, precinct boundaries, and historical turnout data

outputs.name: logistics-plan
outputs.desc: Plan covering polling locations, equipment allocation, and poll worker assignments

outputs.name: election-calendar
outputs.desc: Calendar of election deadlines (filing, registration, early voting, election day)

process: Determine polling locations based on precinct populations and accessibility requirements.
Allocate voting equipment based on projected turnout.
Recruit and assign poll workers to each location.
Set the election calendar with all statutory deadlines.

steps.description: Process candidate filings and voter registration updates.

outputs.name: certified-candidates
outputs.desc: List of candidates certified for the ballot

outputs.name: voter-rolls
outputs.desc: Updated voter registration rolls for the election

process: Receive and verify candidate filing documents and fees.
Certify candidates who meet all eligibility and filing requirements.
Process new voter registrations and address changes through the registration deadline.
Prepare the final voter rolls for each precinct.

steps.description: Conduct early voting and election day voting operations.

inputs.name: certified-candidates
inputs.desc: Certified candidate list for the ballot

outputs.name: voting-records
outputs.desc: Records of all ballots cast (in-person, absentee, provisional)

outputs.name: incident-log
outputs.desc: Log of any voting irregularities or issues

process: Open and manage early voting locations per the election calendar.
Operate election day polling locations with trained poll workers.
Process absentee and provisional ballots per the applicable rules.
Document any irregularities or complaints in the incident log.

steps.description: Tabulate and certify the election results.

outputs.name: certified-results
outputs.desc: The official certified election results

outputs.name: election-administration-record
outputs.desc: Complete election administration file

process: Tabulate all ballots including absentee and provisional where eligible.
Conduct the canvass and verify the tabulation.
Certify the results and publish the official returns.
Compile the complete election administration record for retention.
